MARION COUNTY POLICE DEPARTMENT — INCIDENT REPORT
Report No.: 2024-MCPD-018442
Reporting Officer: M. Halberg, Badge #4471
Date of Incident: March 14, 2024
Time of Incident: 23:42 (per dispatch)
Time of Arrest: 00:08, March 15, 2024
Location: 4500 Linden Avenue (arrest); 4421 Linden Avenue (reported incident)

NARRATIVE:
At approximately 23:47 on March 14, 2024, dispatch received a call from victim ALICIA M. KEMP (DOB 09/12/1991) reporting that an unknown male had grabbed her phone and wallet while she walked southbound on Linden Avenue near the 4400 block. Victim described suspect as a Hispanic male, approximately 5'10", wearing a dark grey hoodie and blue jeans, last seen running northbound.

I responded with Officer J. Bell (Badge #4502). At 00:06 we observed a subject matching the description, later identified as DANIEL R. ORTEGA (DOB 06/30/1996), seated on the curb at 4500 Linden Avenue. Subject was wearing a black hoodie and dark pants.

Upon approach, subject was asked to stand for a Terry frisk. Subject complied initially, then attempted to walk away when I reached toward his right pocket. I placed subject in a control hold. Subject pulled away. Officer Bell and I brought subject to the ground. From subject's right front pocket I recovered one (1) folding knife (blade measured 4.25 inches at the scene). No phone or currency was recovered from subject's person.

Subject was Mirandized at 00:11. Subject stated he understood and declined to answer questions.

Victim was transported to the scene at 00:24. Show-up identification was conducted under streetlight illumination. Victim stated, "I think that's him, but I'm not 100% sure — it happened really fast."

EVIDENCE LOGGED:
- Item 1: Folding knife, recovered from suspect's pocket. Logged 01:14, March 15.
- Item 2: Body-worn camera footage, Officer Halberg, 23:58–00:35.
- Item 3: Body-worn camera footage, Officer Bell — UNAVAILABLE; camera battery failed at 23:51 per equipment log.

No phone, wallet, or currency was recovered.
